meta.source: Matthew Henry, A Method for Prayer (1710). Public domain.
meta.note: Office extras: Lord’s Prayer paraphrase, weekly redemption thanks, standing intercession. Family short forms live on the Method lookup, not in the daily sitting.

paraphrase.pray: Our Father which art in heaven: I come to thee as a child, through Jesus Christ thy Son, in whom thou art well pleased.
Hallowed be thy name. Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth. Let me not take thy name in vain, but sanctify the Lord God in my heart.
Thy kingdom come. Let thy kingdom come in my heart; let the gospel have free course and be glorified; and come, Lord Jesus.
Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God. Not my will, but thine, be done.
Give us this day our daily bread. Feed me with food convenient for me. Having food and raiment, let me be therewith content.
Forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors. Forgive, and I shall be forgiven. Let me forgive, if I have ought against any.
Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation. Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe.
For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen. Unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that I ask or think, unto him be glory.

redemption.title: The resurrection
redemption.pray: The Lord is risen indeed. He was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

redemption.title: The Scriptures
redemption.pray: All scripture is given by inspiration of God. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

redemption.title: The Holy Spirit
redemption.pray: I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter. The love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

redemption.title: The incarnation
redemption.pray: The Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us. Unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

redemption.title: The ascension and intercession
redemption.pray: Thou hast ascended on high. He ever liveth to make intercession for them. We have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

redemption.title: The cross
redemption.pray: God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. The blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

redemption.title: The hope of glory
redemption.pray: Christ in you, the hope of glory. Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which hath begotten us again unto a lively hope.

intercession.pray: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations. The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord.
Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being myself also in the body.
Pray ye the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers. And for them, that utterance may be given, that they may open their mouths boldly.
For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty. The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord.

intercession.cue: Those who do not yet believe
intercession.pray: God our Saviour will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth. My heart’s desire and prayer to God is, that they might be saved.

family.title: A prayer to be used by children

prayers.text: Our Father which art in heaven, I thank thee that thou hast made me, and that thou hast given me thy word. Help me to remember my Creator in the days of my youth.
O Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations. Let thy blessing rest upon this house this day. Let us walk in the light, as he is in the light.
Except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain. I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest us dwell in safety.
All thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children. Suffer the little children to come unto me.
Every creature of God is good, if it be received with thanksgiving. Give us this day our daily bread.
When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
